text:
Ravi (CSM): Hey team — scheduling a focused enablement block for VelaHealth next week. They requested a mix of 1) a hands-on workshop for their ML infra folks, 2) a sandbox demo for product owners, and 3) open office hours for engineers. Can we align on dates/times and who owns each session?

Maya (CS Ops): I can coordinate invites and timezone mapping. What timezone is the primary VelaHealth team in? 

Sarah (VelaHealth): Morning PST for most folks, but we have a couple in CET. Best would be late-morning PST (which is late afternoon CET).

Ravi (CSM): Great — proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue 10:30–12:00 — Hands-on workshop (ML infra)
- Wed 13:00–14:00 — Sandbox demo (product owners)
- Thu 16:00–17:00 — Open office hours (eng drop-in)
Which of these can we staff?

Aisha (Trainer): I can lead the hands-on workshop Tue 10:30. Draft agenda: ```
- 10:30 intro + goals (10m)
- 10:40 infra deep-dive (20m)
- 11:00 guided lab: model pinning + rollout (35m)
- 11:35 Q&A + next steps (25m)
```
Would like a dedicated sandbox for the guided lab — Jon, can we get ephemeral creds?

Jon (Eng): Yep I can provision a sandbox. Suggestion: use a preloaded dataset and a pinned model variant to keep timings tight. I'll have a script to reset state between pairs. ETA for sandbox: Mon EOD.

Maya (CS Ops): I'll send calendar invites once we lock. Quick ask: Sarah, how many VelaHealth attendees per session? We need headcounts for breakout pairs in the lab.

Sarah (VelaHealth): Workshop: 6 infra engineers. Sandbox demo: 8 product folks (PMs + PMM). Office hours: TBD — likely 4–6 drop-ins.

Ravi (CSM): Ok — staffing plan: Aisha (lead) + Jon (sandbox & infra) for Tue workshop; Jon + Ravi for Wed demo; Maya + Ravi for Thu office hours with on-call engineer (TBD).

Aisha (Trainer): For the workshop lab, can the infra engineers have Docker and SSH access? If not, I can adjust to a fully web-based walkthrough.

Jon (Eng): SSH limited — we can do containerized demos via the sandbox UI (no SSH). Works fine.

Maya (CS Ops): I'm drafting the invite. Proposed title: "VelaHealth — Redwood Enablement: Infra Workshop + Sandbox Demo + Office Hours". Any copy edits? Keep short.

Ravi (CSM): Add a bullet in the invite about 'prereqs' — list who should attend and that we'll provision a sandbox account. Also note the session will be recorded.

Sarah (VelaHealth): Please add a short item on security controls + data handling in the workshop agenda. That's a high priority for our compliance team.

Aisha (Trainer): Will add a 10m slot on security controls and KMS notes. Tentative agenda updated.

Jon (Eng): Also propose a 15m mini-demo in the sandbox on KV cache behavior and perf profiling. That helps infra team map to their SLOs.

Ravi (CSM): Nice. Final checklist before sending invites:
- Sandbox provisioned by Mon EOD (Jon)
- Final agenda with security + perf items (Aisha)
- Attendee list & headcount (Sarah)
- Calendar invites + Zoom links (Maya)
- Recording + follow-up playbook to be uploaded to customer folder (Ravi)

Maya (CS Ops): I can send provisional invites now with 'tentative' and follow up once sandbox is ready. Anyone object? :+1: / :-1:

Jon (Eng): +1

Aisha (Trainer): +1

Ravi (CSM): +1

Sarah (VelaHealth): +1 — thanks!

calendar-bot: Event created: "VelaHealth — Redwood Enablement: Infra Workshop" — Tue 10:30–12:00 PST — guests: 6 (tentative). Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.example/abc123

Maya (CS Ops): Sent invites for all three slots as tentative. I'll swap to confirmed once Jon marks the sandbox ready.

Jon (Eng): Sandbox provisioning complete. Username template: vela_user_{n}@sandbox.redwood; temp creds in Slack DM to Sarah.

Sarah (VelaHealth): Got the creds and forwarded to team. Looking forward to Tue. Thank you all! :tada:

Ravi (CSM): I'll pull together the post-session playbook doc and drop it in the customer folder. If anything changes ping here.

Maya (CS Ops): Closing loop — invites updated to "confirmed". See you Tuesday.

Sarah (VelaHealth): See you — and please include the recording for the PMs who are remote.

Ravi (CSM): Will do. Thanks team!
